method.retrieval: TF-IDF over character n-grams (char_wb, 3-5), cosine ranking
method.authorization: allowlist applied as a mask BEFORE scoring; derived from enrolment/ownership in the database

retrieval_quality.honest_reading: n=12 is enough to demonstrate the mechanism works, not to claim production-scale retrieval quality. The abstention threshold was calibrated on this same set, so it is not independently validated.

test_summary: 15 tests passed in the RAG evaluation module (retrieval quality + behavioural boundaries).
limitations: Live LLM answer quality is unverified: no Groq API key has been available, so only the retrieval layer and the local fallback are exercised.
The evaluation corpus is small (12 queries, 6 seeded course materials).
